Marco Diaz (Sales): Passing Orion Therapeutics to CS — signed yesterday, committed to Dedicated 2x A100 for Q2 trial. They asked for VPC + SSO + HSM. Sales notes: expect <10% token overage. Renewal in ~9 months.

Priya Rao (CSM): Thanks Marco — adding onboarding checklist. Who owns SSO config? Any known gaps with our SAML connector?

Marco Diaz (Sales): Internal SSO contact is emma@orion.health (customer). Their IdP is Okta. Sales ran a basic SAML exchange but saw an attribute mismatch. I opened INC-4821 and added initial logs: https://go.redwood/inc/4821

Sam O'Neill (Support): Got it, on the ticket. Looks like assertion is sending 'userPrincipalName' while we expect 'email'. I'll try a mapping and update. Tagging @Nico Park for private deploy KMS/HSM access policy question.

Nico Park (Eng): Noted. For private deploy + HSM we need the customer's KMS policy and the service principal allowed in their account. Also FYI there's a known edge-case in our SSO connector when NameID is transient — fix in PR #1302 (in review). I'll coordinate timeline with eng-releases.

Olivia Chen (Enablement): I can run a 60-min onboarding workshop next Wed 9 AM PST. Need confirmed attendees from the customer and an infra diagram. Priya — can you capture the initial eval prompts so we can run a perf baseline during the workshop?

Priya Rao (CSM): Yup — will capture prompts and a short eval matrix.

Marco Diaz (Sales): Customer confirmed workshop Wed. Attendees: Emma (IdP lead) + Carlos (infra).

Priya Rao (CSM): Action list (owners + target dates):
- Priya: create eval prompts + baseline tests — due 2023-03-15
- Sam: triage SAML mapping in INC-4821 and post results — due 2023-03-12
- Nico: review KMS/HSM policy needs and PR #1302 ETA — due 2023-03-14
- Olivia: schedule workshop invite + Miro board + invite list — due 2023-03-10
- Marco: share customer contact details & provisioning contacts — done

Sam O'Neill (Support): Quick workaround: map NameID -> email in Okta app profile. Example patch (staging tested):
```
PATCH /api/v1/apps/{appId}/profile/attributeMappings
{
  "mappings": [
    { "userAttribute": "email", "appAttribute": "NameID" }
  ]
}
```
Will try on INC-4821 test session Tue 17:00 PST.

Nico Park (Eng): If mapping fails we may need a tiny adapter service to normalize attributes. ETA for PR once I have KMS policy: ~2 business days. If it's blocking, we can hotfix the connector.

Priya Rao (CSM): Renewal-risk note: medium. Customer usage is expected to grow, but legal discussions on data residency and HSM controls could push timeline. I'll add to renewal watch and set monthly cadence.

Marco Diaz (Sales): Sales will stay engaged on legal side. @Priya escalate to me if provisioning or HSM consent delays exceed 1 week.

Priya Rao (CSM): Will do. Adding owners to INC-4821 and this thread for visibility.

Olivia Chen (Enablement): Also capturing feedback: customer asked for a private-KMS quickstart (docs missing a short guide). I'll open doc issue RD-845 and draft a short checklist.

Nico Park (Eng): Adding RD-845 to backlog. If it's blocking onboarding we can prioritize.

Priya Rao (CSM): Summary checklist status:
- SAML mapping: in progress (Sam)
- KMS/HSM policy: pending customer doc (Nico)
- Workshop scheduled: Wed 9 AM PST (Olivia)
- Eval prompts: drafting (Priya)
- Doc quickstart: RD-845 (Olivia)

deploy-bot: Provisioning plan created for dedicated pool: plan-id dp-7782 — scheduled 2023-03-20 02:00 UTC.

Sam O'Neill (Support): Updated INC-4821 with mapping steps and test window. Will post logs to the ticket after Tue test.

Priya Rao (CSM): Thanks everyone — I'll run evals once infra is green and post updates here. :thumbsup:

Marco Diaz (Sales): Passing off complete from sales side. Continue ops sync here.

Priya Rao (CSM): Closing the high-level handoff — keeping renewal watch and escalation path open. I'll update this thread and INC-4821 with any blockers.
